name: Private sign-in, chat, and sign-out
description: Sign in, obtain an Arabic reply, and verify sign-out clears private data.
steps: Verify the login screen displays the DAI floating-face SVG logo instead of the large textual ضي placeholder, and its image loads without errors.
Before sign-in, verify /api/conversations and /api/settings reject anonymous access and display no private data.
Use the available test authentication provider to sign in.
Send أهلاً يا ضي and wait for a nonempty Arabic reply. Expand نص المحادثة and verify both turns.
Verify the character is a floating face without a solid head, ears, or body.
Sign out and verify chat and transcript disappear.
expected: Protected APIs reject anonymous access; authenticated chat responds and sign-out returns to the logo login screen.

name: Conversation durability, isolation, and deletion
description: Create a test conversation, reload it, verify ownership rejection, and remove it.
setup: Sign in as Actor A and create a conversation by sending تجربة حفظ ضي.
steps: Reload and open the saved conversation. Verify the user message and reply in نص المحادثة.
As Actor B in a separate authenticated session, attempt to read, chat in, and delete Actor A's conversation ID. All attempts must return 404 and not change Actor A's data.
As Actor A open المحادثات, delete the test conversation, confirm, and reload.
expected: Messages survive reload; another user cannot access or mutate them; confirmed deletion stays deleted.

name: Mobile settings, character gestures, and upload guardrail
description: Exercise persistent settings and original character states on a phone.
steps: Sign in and verify the DAI logo is horizontally centered in the main workspace and an empty composer cannot send.
Verify the DAI logo is centered while the DaiFace animation remains active behind/around it and the composer stays reachable.
Open الإعدادات, toggle البحث التلقائي, close, reload, and verify the choice persisted.
Close settings. Select صيد, قلب, رقصة, فكرة, بحث, and نعاس one at a time; verify Canvas changes and the composer remains reachable without horizontal page overflow.
Toggle حركة هادية and verify large looping movement stops.
Upload a real text/plain test file named dai-test.txt. Verify its link appears and the UI accurately says content analysis is not yet available.
Try uploading a file larger than 2MB and verify rejection. If browser speech recognition is unavailable, verify typing still works.
expected: Mobile UI remains usable, settings persist, gestures have no bear shell, valid uploads work, and oversized uploads fail visibly.

name: Chat failure preserves draft
description: An API failure must leave the user's message recoverable.
steps: Sign in and type رسالة اختبار فشل الإرسال.
Send and wait for the error.
Verify the same text is restored to the composer and the send button becomes available.
expected: A visible error appears, the draft is restored, and no fabricated assistant answer is shown.

name: Research sources and settings failure
description: Show real source references when available and keep settings unchanged if saving fails.
steps: Sign in and note the current البحث التلقائي setting. Attempt to toggle it.
Verify a visible save error and the old checkbox value remains.
Close settings. If automatic research is enabled, send ابحث عن القمر and wait for the reply.
Verify links, if supplied, use HTTP or HTTPS. If no sources were found the reply must not claim current live verification.
expected: Failed settings saves are visible without false success; research produces sources or an honest lack-of-sources response.
